lessons.title: Why Deep Learning? 🌊
lessons.description: Explore how stacking many layers creates hierarchical features and the rise of deep neural networks.

lessons.title: Convolutional Layers 🧱
lessons.description: Understand filters, feature maps, stride, padding, and how convolution extracts visual patterns.

lessons.title: Pooling & Fully Connected Layers 🏊
lessons.description: Downsample with pooling, flatten feature maps, and connect to a classifier for image recognition.

lessons.title: CNN Architectures: LeNet to ResNet 🏗️
lessons.description: From the 1998 classic to modern residual networks, learn the design patterns that won ImageNet.

lessons.title: Training CNNs & Data Augmentation 🏋️
lessons.description: Fight overfitting with augmentation, dropout, and transfer learning; tune a CNN effectively.

lessons.title: Building a CNN with Keras 🐍
lessons.description: Hands‑on: code a CNN for MNIST or CIFAR‑10, compile, train, and evaluate — from scratch to high accuracy.
